title: Sheehan gets an injunction against the Scientology grand jury subpoenas

plain: A lawyer named Dan Sheehan, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says that in the 1970s he went to New York to fight subpoenas, court orders forcing people to testify, that a grand jury had aimed at the Church of Scientology. Sheehan says he was licensed to practise in the federal court for southern New York, and that he got an injunction there, a court order that shut the subpoenas down. He tells it as part of his story of a career spent in the middle of big, contested legal fights.
